rulesStrings.li: headline->[FACTION_A] builds a new settlement near [DETAIL]
headline->Settlers of [FACTION_A] break ground near [DETAIL]
story->[LEAD] settlers from [FACTION_A] have begun building a new town near [DETAIL], at the edge of its lands. [cb_detail] [closing]
cb_detail->Until the walls are up, the site is said to be lightly guarded.
cb_detail->[observers] see it as a sign that [FACTION_A] means to grow.
cb_detail->Neighbours are watching the new site closely.
headline->[FACTION_A] founds [DETAIL]
headline->New town of [DETAIL] stands, says [FACTION_A]
story->[LEAD] [FACTION_A] has finished building the new settlement of [DETAIL]. [sf_detail] [closing]
sf_detail->The first families are already moving in.
sf_detail->[LEADER_A] has called it proof of the faction's strength.
sf_detail->Its claim on the surrounding land is expected to follow.
headline->[FACTION_A] attacks settlers of [FACTION_B] near [DETAIL]
headline->Settlement site of [FACTION_B] raided
story->[LEAD] forces of [FACTION_A] have attacked a settlement under construction by [FACTION_B] near [DETAIL]. [cr_detail] [closing]
cr_detail->[FACTION_B] has called it an unprovoked attack on peaceful settlers.
cr_detail->The builders are said to have had little time to prepare.
cr_detail->[observers] expect [FACTION_B] to demand redress.
headline->Trade convoy of [FACTION_A] lost on the road from [DETAIL]
headline->Caravan from [DETAIL] destroyed
story->[LEAD] a trade convoy of [FACTION_A] bound from [DETAIL] has been destroyed on the road, attacked by [FACTION_B]. [cl_detail] [closing]
cl_detail->Its goods were carried off and the drivers have not been seen since.
cl_detail->Merchants say the route is becoming too dangerous to use.
cl_detail->[observers] fear for the future of the trade route.
headline->Hunger in [FACTION_A]
headline->[FACTION_A] runs out of food
headline->Empty granaries in [CAPITAL_A]
story->[LEAD] the stores of [FACTION_A] can no longer feed its people. [st_detail] [st_politics] [closing]
st_detail->Families are said to be eating seed grain and boiling leather.
st_detail->Rationing has been ordered, and the queues are long and angry.
st_detail->The old and the very young are suffering first.
st_detail->Traders report that the markets of [CAPITAL_A] have nothing left to sell.
st_politics->[LEADER_A] is under growing pressure to do something, anything.
st_politics->[observers] warn that hungry people do not stay patient for long.
st_politics->Relief caravans, from anyone, would be welcomed.
headline->[FACTION_A] raids the stores of [FACTION_B]
headline->Raiders hit [FACTION_B] warehouses
story->[LEAD] raiders of [FACTION_A] have broken into the stores of [FACTION_B] and carried off [DETAIL]. [pt_detail] [closing]
pt_detail->Guards were reportedly asleep, drunk, or both.
pt_detail->[FACTION_B] has promised to hunt the thieves down.
pt_detail->Merchants are hiring more guards and charging more for everything.
headline->[FACTION_A] founds [DETAIL]
headline->New town of [DETAIL] for [FACTION_A]
headline->[FACTION_A] grows: settlers found [DETAIL]
story->[LEAD] [FACTION_A] has founded the new settlement of [DETAIL]. [ex_why] [ex_detail] [closing]
ex_why->Its towns had grown too crowded, and its treasury could bear the cost.
ex_why->Years of growth have left its old towns bursting at the seams.
ex_why->The faction's stores are full and its people many, and land was there for the taking.
ex_detail->The first families are already raising walls.
ex_detail->[LEADER_A] has called it proof of the faction's strength.
ex_detail->Settlers left [CAPITAL_A] in long wagon trains to make the journey.
ex_detail->[observers] expect its neighbours to watch the new town closely.
headline->[FACTION_A] settles again at [DETAIL]
headline->The wanderers of [FACTION_A] build a home
story->[LEAD] [FACTION_A], which had been left without a single town, has settled again and founded [DETAIL]. [rs_detail] [closing]
rs_detail->After seasons on the road, its people have numbers enough to put down roots.
rs_detail->[LEADER_A] has promised that the faction will never again be homeless.
rs_detail->[observers] had written the faction off; they may have spoken too soon.
headline->[FACTION_A] abandons [DETAIL]
headline->[DETAIL] left in ruins
story->[LEAD] [FACTION_A] has given up the settlement of [DETAIL], which no longer had people enough to keep it going. [ab_detail] [closing]
ab_detail->Its last residents have moved to the faction's other towns.
ab_detail->Only empty houses and cold hearths are left.
ab_detail->[observers] see it as a sign of a faction in decline.
